notes: All 12 views inspected. Bo-Bo electric locomotive in pale blue with a cream roof, two roof pantographs with modelled scissor arms and contact shoes, roof insulators and cable runs, body-side grilles and windows, headlight and marker lenses, buffers and couplers at both ends, and two bogies with brake detail. The underside is a complete chassis. Both cabs are modelled. No operator livery, number or logo.
limitations: Stylised Cozy-kit palette rather than photoreal materials.
Pantographs and wheels are fused into the body mesh, so the pantographs cannot be raised or lowered without mesh separation.
method: Visual inspection of local-model renders and technical reports
